headings.title: Ten-year limitation for defective real property improvements
headings.reviewNote: Requires actions for damages, contribution, or indemnity arising from a defective or unsafe condition of a real property improvement to be commenced within ten years of completion.

headings.title: Application restricted to design, planning, and construction professionals
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section application to actions against persons whose sole connection with the improvement is performing or furnishing design, planning, architectural, engineering, or construction services.

headings.title: One-year extension for contribution and indemnity claims
headings.reviewNote: Permits a subsection 2 defendant to commence a contribution or indemnity action within one year of the initial filing notwithstanding subsection 1.

headings.title: Exceptions for other bars, concealed defects, and owners
headings.reviewNote: Excludes actions barred by another provision of law, concealment of a defect or deficiency directly causing the condition, and actions against real estate owners or possessors.

headings.title: Commencement date for buildings completed on August 13, 1976
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the limitation period for buildings completed on August 13, 1976 begins to run on that date.

headings.title: Commencement of ten-year period from issuance of occupancy permit
headings.reviewNote: Provides that notwithstanding subsection 1, when an occupancy permit is issued, the ten-year period commences on the issuance date.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 6 subsections, statutory history, and 2000 Lay v. P & G Health Care annotation; revised subsection 1 to neutral statutory wording, subsection 4 to include other-law bar and remove unstated 'fraudulent' modifier from note.

headings.title: Two-year limit and ten-year cap for health care malpractice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes two-year limitation from act of neglect for malpractice actions against listed health care and chapter 337 mental health providers, with foreign-object, failure-to-inform (post-Aug 28, 1997 tests), and minor exceptions and a ten-year/age-twenty cap.

headings.title: One-hundred-eighty-day service deadline following limitations expiration
headings.reviewNote: Requires service made after subsection 1 limitations or extension expires to occur within 180 days of petition filing, mandating dismissal (with prejudice if prior nonsuit).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, section 538.305 cross-reference, and 5 case annotations (Goodman, McLeran, Batek, Ambers-Phillips, Brick); tightened subsection 1 title for health care/mental health scope and corrected subsection 2 note to clarify post-expiration service deadline.

headings.title: Twenty-year limitation commencement when mortgage maturity date indeterminable
headings.reviewNote: Sets fallback sequence (execution, acknowledgment, recording, or original obligation date) for the section 516.150 twenty-year period on mortgages/deeds of trust recorded after January 1, 1979 without face-determinable maturity.

headings.title: Twenty-year limitation commencement for future advance security instruments
headings.reviewNote: Starts the section 516.150 twenty-year period on the twentieth anniversary of execution, acknowledgment, or recording for section 443.055 future-advance security instruments recorded after September 1, 1992.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and statutory history; fallback trigger sequence for post-Jan 1, 1979 indeterminable-maturity mortgages and twentieth-anniversary trigger for post-Sept 1, 1992 section 443.055 future-advance instruments verified.

headings.title: Ten-year conclusive presumption of payment for court judgments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes conclusive ten-year presumption of payment from rendition, personal-service revival, or recorded payment (excluding periodic support/maintenance and marital benefit divisions), and provides emancipation actions do not revive support orders.

headings.title: Ten-year presumption of payment for periodic child support and maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Presumes each periodic child support or maintenance payment satisfied ten years after due date unless revived under subsection 1, effective for judgments not presumed paid as of August 31, 1982.

headings.title: Ten-year payment presumption for periodic marital benefit divisions
headings.reviewNote: Presumes each periodic marital pension, retirement, life insurance, or employee benefit division payment satisfied ten years after due date unless revived, effective as of August 28, 2001.

headings.title: Recording child support or maintenance in automated system
headings.reviewNote: Includes chapter 454 automated child support system recording of payments or credits by the family support division or payment center as payment duly entered on the record for child support or maintenance.

headings.title: Revival of judgments for unpaid rent by publication
headings.reviewNote: Permits revival of judgments, orders, or decrees awarding unpaid rent by publication consistent with section 506.160 without personal service.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all 5 subsections, statutory history, and 2 case annotations (In re Marriage of Holt, Walls v. Walls); tightened subsections 3 and 4 titles and verified maintenance/credit inclusion in automated child support system recording.
